notes.text:
NE555P LED flasher:
- Created led_flasher.kicad_pro/.kicad_sch in /home/cua/kicad_project/ via GUI. Step 71 has clean title and explicit saved status.
- Timer:NE555P pin 8 VCC and 4 RESET to +5V; 1 GND; 7 discharge to R1/R2 junction; 2 and 6 to R2/C1 junction; 5 to C2; 3 to R3 and J2.1.
- Device:R values R1=1k, R2=50k, R3=330; C_Polarized C1=10uF positive upward; C2=0.01uF; LED rotated once gives cathode down. Screw_Terminal_01x02 input J1 mirrored x for right-facing pins; duplicate J2 mirrored back. Both pin2 returns GND.
- Plain GND duplicated directly onto all six return endpoints. Crossing control wire has no junction at output or VCC crossings.
- ERC step70: only two undriven input-power errors (#PWR01 +5V, #PWR02 GND), zero warnings. Clear markers (440,722), Close (605,722), Ctrl+S. No extra power flags or signal labels.
- No feedback errors recorded; chooser/property inspection before typing and short queued placement/wire batches worked. No netlist export requested or performed.
- Prior simple value edits scored 1.00 while full circuits ranged 0.00-0.67; these support save/edit workflow, not exact reference agreement. Current design is visually audited against intent and checked by ERC; its evaluator score is unavailable. +5V is an engineering assumption because task omitted voltage.
